source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of tree properties (PDF 106-108).

items: Root node: pehla ya sab se oopar wala node, jaise woh markazi folder jis mein baqi tamam folders aur files hon.
Edges aur nodes: nodes elements hain aur edges unhein jorne wali lines; jis node ke bachche na hon woh leaf hai, jaise folder mein file.
Height: root se sab se door leaf tak sab se lamba raasta, jo batata hai ke tree kitna uncha hai.
Mutawazin trees: baen aur daen shaakhein taqreeban barabar unchi (topic 4.1.7).

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
class FamilyMember:
....def __init__(self, name):
........self.name = name
........self.children = []

class FamilyTree:
....def __init__(self, ancestor_name):
........self.root = FamilyMember(ancestor_name)

....def add_child(self, parent_name, child_name):
........parent = self._find_member(self.root, parent_name)
........if parent:
............parent.children.append(FamilyMember(child_name))

....def _find_member(self, current, name):
........if current.name == name:
............return current
........for child in current.children:
............result = self._find_member(child, name)
............if result:
................return result
........return None

family = FamilyTree("Grandparent")
family.add_child("Grandparent", "Parent1")
family.add_child("Grandparent", "Parent2")
family.add_child("Parent1", "Child1")
family.add_child("Parent1", "Child2")

FamilyMember ek shakhs hai jis ka naam aur bachchon ki list hai; FamilyTree root wale buzurg se poora tree sambhalta, bachche jorta aur tree mein recursive talash se afraad dhoondta hai. Nateeja: Grandparent ke Parent1 aur Parent2, aur Parent1 ke Child1 aur Child2 (Figure 4.6).

blocks.explanation: (a) root se sab se gehre node tak edges ki tadaad, jo 'root se sab se door leaf tak sab se lamba raasta' se mel khata hai.

items: Tree ki istilahat: root, nodes, edges, leaf, height; FamilyTree class bachchon ko lists mein rakhti hai.
